claim: The generated dynamic Team topology is projected onto the explicit strategy plan. Single-deliverable forced Team keeps producer+critic; leader is added only for multi-source or multiple actual deliverables. Removed roles are rewired out of the DAG and their declared/default turn ceilings are counted as saved budget.

static_budget_example.basis: producer 4 + critic 2 + planner 4 + unplanned leader default 12; configured ceilings, not measured calls

limitations: No Cargo compilation, tests, or live Team execution was run.
The 22-to-6 comparison is a configured turn-ceiling calculation, not observed usage or latency.
Only generated dynamic Team roles are projected; versioned templates and user-authored roles keep their declared topology.
A live task must confirm that review findings reliably reopen the original producer and final delivery remains complete.
